entries.title: Choose your first project folder from your computer's folder picker
entries.body: On the welcome card, Work in a folder on my computer now opens your computer's folder picker. The folder you choose becomes a project, the card names it, and the message box is ready for what you want done with it. A folder you drop on the message box offers to add it as a project. When the first mate cannot find a folder you named, it offers folders with a similar name and a Choose folder button.

picture.alt: The welcome card after choosing a folder named meter, saying it added meter as a project and started git in it, and pointing at the message box.
